# Eetu Rantanen

> Freelance software developer available for hire, with over 13 years of professional experience. Game development is the main focus, alongside web development, data and analytics, and AI solutions and consulting.

Eetu Rantanen is based in Tampere, Finland and works remotely with clients worldwide, taking on contract, freelance, and permanent work. erantanen.com is a single-page site covering these services in detail, client testimonials, and contact information. Direct enquiries go to eetu@erantanen.com.
